content.name: Sneha Iyer
content.title: Associate Front-End Developer
content.summary: Associate front-end developer two years out of engineering college, building React screens for a doctor-booking app used in three Indian cities. Made the Kannada and Tamil versions of the booking flow work properly on low-cost Android phones. Looking to grow towards performance and accessibility work.

experience.title: Front-End Intern
bullets: Built product listing and filter pages in React for a handloom marketplace with about 1,800 artisan sellers.
Converted 120 product images to WebP and added lazy loading, bringing the home page under 1 MB.
Fixed checkout layout issues in Hindi and Kannada where longer labels overflowed buttons.

experience.title: Associate Front-End Developer
bullets: Develop doctor search and appointment booking screens in React and TypeScript for a platform taking 6,000 bookings a day across three cities.
Added Kannada and Tamil translations with proper font fallbacks, after which bookings from regional-language users rose 21%.
Cut JavaScript bundle size by 28% by splitting routes and removing an unused date library, improving load on entry-level Android phones.
Wrote React Testing Library tests for the payment step, covering UPI, card and pay-at-clinic options.

education.details: CGPA 8.7/10. Final-year project: offline-first attendance app for rural schools.

education.degree: Class XII (CBSE), Science with Computer Science
